subject.summary: One run of NetLogo's Flocking: 300 birds, each following three rules (align, cohere, separate). Each bird's track rises with time: near the floor they fly every which way; by tick 49 half the headings agree, by tick 81 nearly all, and the tracks lean together as parallel streams.
